scope: All 293 original catalogue rows and 543 additional records, leads or controls. Verification level is recorded at each site.

principal.definition: Climactic Mazama airborne bulk fallout. 31 point values, 137 lower limits and 75 upper limits are shared by all five families. Core duplicates and inferred phase totals carry explicit qualifications. The current input incorporates the published Yellowstone core data, Lyman Lake and the Ruby Mountain, Great Salt Lake, Mazama source and thicknessless-site reviews, Young’s separately mapped upper pumice sections, the Round Meadow borings, North Cascades and British Columbia lake cores, northern Idaho lake packages, Mount Baker field sections and the distal deposit-nature revision. Bounds and sensitivity alternatives are in the locality ledger.

principal_limits.derivation: The 5 cm tephra V is independently measured and compositionally distinguished from tephra VI. The investigators specifically discuss rapid settling and possible subaqueous flow in connection with its unusual magnetic direction. The logged deposit may exceed local fallout.
principal_limits.qualifications: Conditional on complete local retention within this package and sufficient thickness after compaction. Extra catchment or lake sediment can enlarge the package. Erosion, compaction, or noncapture can invalidate the ceiling.

principal_limits.derivation: Table S2 places ash at 102 cm between wood samples at 75.5 and 130 cm. The enclosing 54.5 cm is a gross ceiling under full capture. The older age of reworked wood at 130 cm invalidates that radiocarbon tie for the age model; its physical depth is documented. S1’s 1 cm is retained separately as a compilation reading.
principal_limits.qualifications: Conditional on complete local retention within this package and sufficient thickness after compaction. Extra catchment or lake sediment can enlarge the package. Erosion, compaction, or noncapture can invalidate the ceiling.

principal_limits.derivation: Mehringer and Wigand1986, Journal of Arid Environments11:117–138, doi:10.1016/S0140-1963(18)31224-2; pp.118,122–125 and Fig.7; original indexed full text, scan not recovered. Source-estimated original fallout ceiling, conservatively widened to5 cm; not a direct5 cm bed
principal_limits.qualifications: Original local climactic fallout, conditional on the author primary-fall estimate and treating target as contained in their Mazama package. Published1986, not1996 as some repository metadata states. Most mapped ash-rich sediments contain less than10% unmixed primary ash; 25 cm mixed deposit is excluded. Do not multiply this percentage into a thickness. Quantitative basis of original estimate is not fully documented; test isolated omission and a weaker10 cm upper ceiling. If two falls include a precursor, an upper bound on their nonnegative sum also bounds the climactic share. Exact decimal typography pending.

principal_limits.derivation: Dyck et al. (1965), p.33. The bottom of the overlying muck sample is 70 cm and the top of the underlying sample is 75 cm, leaving at most 5 cm for the observed bed.
principal_limits.qualifications: Conditional on the authors’ 70 cm horizon being climactic Mazama, both samples clearing the bed, sufficiently complete primary capture and negligible erosion/compaction. Double to 10 cm and omit in source checks.

principal_limits.derivation: The thesis and published chronology place the complete 2 cm Beaver Lake interval at different composite depths. A common 2 cm package in the lake can allow lateral addition without imposing a positive original minimum.

principal_limits.derivation: The two identified non-target stratigraphic levels in B100NC-1 enclose at most 151.25 − 137.5 = 13.75 cm. Uses the primary Table 2 bracket without assuming which bed contact 147.5 cm represents.

principal_limits.derivation: Entire visible horizon lies between two independently dated plant macrofossil levels. 440 − 320.5 = 119.5 cm.

Transferring it to original local fall requires continuous recovery across the bracket with no net thinning sufficient to violate it. Stratigraphic order and bed attribution must hold. Several hundred mg of each tephra were prepared for analysis. Processing yield, ash purity and focusing prevent calibration of a precise original bulk thickness from mounted material.

target: Climactic Mazama primary airborne bulk deposit, including co-ignimbrite ash; exclude identified older precursor units and flow/reworked material. Legacy phase correlations remain conditional where primary logs are unavailable.
thickness_convention: Preserved bulk centimetres as a proxy for original local deposition. No universal decompaction correction. Component lower bounds assume in-place primary pumice without depositional thickening.
coordinate_datum: Published decimal or DMS positions used without an undocumented datum conversion; precision does not establish survey accuracy.

prior_release.scope: Current GitHub release preceding the Mazama source revision; the earlier local audit was performed on41b8f2f. Latest five-family results remain accessible at this immutable revision.
